definitions.explanation: The area along the edge of a river.

examples.japanese: {川辺|かわべ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}した→散歩する：26840_sanposuru⟧。
examples.english: I took a walk along the riverbank.

examples.japanese: {川辺|かわべ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}って→座る：00757_suwaru⟧⟦{弁当|べんとう}→弁当：01014_bentou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I sat by the river and ate my lunch.

examples.japanese: ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{川辺|かわべ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一斉|いっせい}→一斉：01726_issei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{咲|さ}き→咲く：08150_saku⟧、⟦{花見|はなみ}→花見：01700_hanami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧にぎわう。
examples.english: In spring, the cherry blossoms along the river bloom all at once, and the area bustles with people enjoying hanami.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧ (river) + {辺|べ} (vicinity, edge). A simple, everyday word for the area beside a river. Also read as かわべり in some contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {川辺|かわべ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧: to walk along the riverside
- {川辺|かわべ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}る→座る：00757_suwaru⟧: to sit by the river
- {川辺|かわべ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{風景|ふうけい}→風景：03591_fuukei⟧: riverside scenery
- {川辺|かわべ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧: riverside park

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{川岸|かわぎし}→川岸：24545_kawagishi⟧: riverbank — focuses more on the bank/embankment itself
- ⟦{岸辺|きしべ}→岸辺：20225_kishibe⟧: shore, bank — broader, can be used for lakes and seas too
- ⟦{河川敷|かせんしき}→河川敷：24122_kasenshiki⟧: riverbed area — the flat area between the river and the levee
